people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.
translations.bsb: And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
translations.kjv: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
translations.asv: And the people cried unto Moses; and Moses prayed unto Jehovah, and the fire abated.
